rows.name: Health Information Technology Council
rows.constituent: Health IT professionals, providers & all MA residents
rows.mandate: Advises the Governor on health IT policy, EHR adoption, and interoperability standards across Massachusetts' healthcare system. Oversees statewide health data exchange strategy and digital health innovation.

rows.name: Digital Accessibility & Equity Governance Board
rows.constituent: Residents with disabilities · all MA digital users
rows.mandate: Implements Governor Healey's Executive Order #614 on digital equity. Governs accessibility standards for state digital services, technology inclusion policy, and digital access for residents with disabilities.
rows.criticalNote: EO #614 body · digital equity policy pending

rows.name: Massachusetts Health Policy Commission
rows.constituent: All Massachusetts residents · health cost control
rows.mandate: Independent state agency that monitors healthcare cost growth, sets spending benchmarks, and advises on health system transformation for all Massachusetts residents.

rows.name: MassHealth Care Delivery Advisory Council
rows.mandate: Advises the Secretary of Health & Human Services on MassHealth (Medicaid) program delivery, care coordination models, and health IT systems serving 2.2M enrollees.

rows.name: Governor's Special Advisory Commission on Disability Policy
rows.mandate: Re-established October 2025 — advises Governor Healey on disability policy priorities, program gaps, and systemic barriers for 1.2M Massachusetts residents with disabilities. Currently filling seats.

rows.name: Behavioral Health Advisory Council
rows.constituent: Residents with mental health & SUD needs
rows.mandate: Advises on Massachusetts' behavioral health system transformation, crisis response capacity, and evidence-based programs for residents with mental health and substance use disorder needs.

rows.name: Board of Registration in Medicine — Public Member Seats
rows.mandate: Regulates the licensure and discipline of Massachusetts physicians. Public member seats provide accountability and community perspective in licensing decisions affecting patients statewide.

rows.name: Commission on Unlocking Housing Production
rows.mandate: Created by the 2024 Affordable Homes Act — advises on zoning reform, housing production barriers, and affordable housing strategy for all Massachusetts residents.

rows.name: Governor's Advisory Council for Refugees & Immigrants
rows.mandate: Advises on programs and services for Massachusetts' ~750,000 foreign-born residents. Makes policy recommendations on integration, language access, economic mobility, and refugee resettlement.

rows.name: Massachusetts Commission on Indian Affairs
rows.mandate: Advocates for the rights and interests of Native American residents of Massachusetts. Advises state government on tribal sovereignty, cultural preservation, and access to state services.

rows.name: Board of Elementary and Secondary Education
rows.mandate: Sets education policy for 900,000+ Massachusetts public school students. Establishes academic standards, accountability frameworks, and oversees equity and innovation in public education.

rows.name: Council on Aging Advisory Council
rows.mandate: Advises the Executive Office of Elder Affairs on programs and services for Massachusetts' 1.4M residents 60+. Reviews elder care policy and advocates for aging-in-place, economic security, and health access.

rows.name: Criminal History Systems Board
rows.mandate: Governs Massachusetts' CORI (Criminal Offender Record Information) system. Sets data access policy, oversees data governance, and advises on criminal history reform affecting all MA residents.

rows.name: State Ethics Commission
rows.mandate: Enforces Massachusetts' conflict of interest and financial disclosure laws for public officials. AG appointment seat — provides independent oversight of government ethics statewide.
